units.source_text: 夕雾往见源氏大臣，将此事禀告，并将内大臣来信呈阅。

en.t: Yugiri went to see the Genji Minister, reported the matter to him, and presented the letter from the Minister of the Interior for him to read.

units.source_text: 源氏大臣看了信，说道：“他招你去，一定是有意思的。

en.t: The Genji Minister read the letter and said, "There must be some meaning in his inviting you there.

units.source_text: 如此主动求上门来，则过去违背太君遗志的不孝之罪也消解了。”

en.t: Since he has taken the initiative and come seeking you in this way, the old charge of unfilial conduct in going against the lady's wishes is resolved as well."

units.source_text: 他那骄矜之色，令人讨厌。

en.t: His proud and self-satisfied manner was unpleasant.

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“不见得有意思吧。

en.t: Yugiri answered, "I doubt there is any particular meaning in it.

units.source_text: 只因他家正殿旁边的紫藤花今年开得特别茂盛，此时又值闲居无事，故作管弦之会，招我去参加罢了。”

en.t: It is only that the wisteria beside the main hall at his house has bloomed especially luxuriantly this year, and since he happens to be at leisure, he is holding a music gathering and has invited me to attend."

units.source_text: 源氏大臣说：“总之，他特地遣使来请，你应该即速前去。”

en.t: The Genji Minister said, "In any case, since he has gone to the trouble of sending a messenger to invite you, you should go at once."
He gave Yugiri permission to accept the invitation.

units.source_text: 夕雾不知内大臣究有何意，心中怀疑，惶惑不安。

en.t: Yugiri did not know what the Minister of the Interior truly intended, and he felt doubtful, bewildered, and uneasy.

units.source_text: 源氏大臣对他说道：“你的袍子颜色太深，质地也太轻了。

en.t: The Genji Minister said to him, "The color of your robe is too dark, and the fabric is too light.

units.source_text: 如果不是参议，或者没有官职的青年人，原不妨穿你那种浅紫色袍子。

en.t: If you were not a councillor, or if you were a young man without an official post, there would be no harm in wearing that sort of pale purple robe.

units.source_text: 但你是参议，衣冠须得讲究些。”

en.t: But you are a councillor, so you must take more care with your formal attire."

units.source_text: 便把自己穿的一件华美的常礼服，配以非常讲究的衬衣，叫随从者拿了送往夕雾室中。

en.t: He then took a splendid formal robe of his own, paired it with a very carefully chosen undergarment, and had an attendant carry them to Yugiri's room.
